text:
maya: Quick sync — SDK v1.4 changelog cutoff is Friday 4pm PT. Who owns final sampleapp updates and docs updates? Need owners + PRs by EOD Thu. cc @alex @dennis

alex: I can take sampleapp Android updates. Will open PR by Wednesday. Need final API surface confirmation.

dennis: I'll own docs (pulling copy from product). ETA Thu morning. Any breaking changes I should call out in the notes?

priya: Heads up — small codegen flag rename in runtime that affects examples. Not a runtime API rename, but examples will break if not updated. I'll post the diff.

samir: I'll run CI smoketests for sampleapps once PRs are in. Ping me with links; aiming for green by Thursday EOD.

maya: @priya what's the scope — is it just CLI flags or constructor args too?

priya: just CLI flag: --client_opts -> --client-config. No constructor changes. Example fix is mechanical:

```bash
# one-off sed in sample apps
sed -i 's/--client_opts/--client-config/g' samples/**/run.sh
```

alex: perfect. I'll apply that and update README snippets. tagging PR with label "devex/needs-docs" so you can spot it, @dennis.

ci-bot: [build] sampleapp-android #342 failed: lint errors in examples/src/MainActivity.kt

alex: ack, fixing lint now, will force-push in ~10m.

dennis: If docs are ready Thu morning we can freeze changelog and cut release Friday morning. Need product sign-off before cutting.

maya: noted. Also FYI dedicated infra team has rolling maintenance Fri 6pm PT — avoid heavy test runs then.

samir: thanks, will schedule smoke runs before 3pm Fri.

maya: updated plan: PRs in by Thu EOD, CI smoke by Fri 3pm, docs sign-off Thu morning. I'll loop product for final OK.

alex: sounds good. I'll drop PR links here when ready. :thumbsup:
